rv.q: But her voice comes across here, fresh, strong and proud, in this reborn gem of a theatre in Hackney.
The Yard is the most significant new fringe venue in the capital of the past 20 years.
The cast – Nadine Higgin, Tatenda Matsvai, Ibilola Rossi, Cherrelle Skeete and Alex Thomas-Smith – perform as though Shange's words are being drawn from somewhere deep within them.

Page’s production has an excellent cast, who deliver the necessary intensity and occasional hilarity, and perform choreographer Ingrid Mackinnon’s moves with evident pleasure as well as concentration.

cn.t: Critics mostly praise this 50th-anniversary revival of Shange's groundbreaking choreopoem, lauding its poetic power and timely exploration of Black women's experiences, though one finds the production less impactful.
